rules.prompt: Customer may be considering cancelling. Acknowledge their frustration, ask what's driving it, and offer retention options before processing.
Billing topic detected. Verify the account holder, then pull up recent invoices and payment history.
Customer is asking for escalation. Stay calm, summarize the issue back to them, and follow the escalation policy.
Possible service issue. Check the status page for known outages and collect device/location details.
Recording concern raised. Confirm the customer's preference and follow the recording-consent procedure.
